bear_assumptions: The USD 16.70 raised adjusted-EPS guidance midpoint receives a 25x multiple as backlog conversion normalizes and acquisition funding, leverage, labor, fixed-price contract and goodwill risks compress the premium.
base_assumptions: The USD 16.70 raised adjusted-EPS guidance midpoint receives a 32x multiple as record RPO, backlog, Electric margins and cash conversion persist while acquisition and execution risks remain.
bull_assumptions: The USD 16.70 raised adjusted-EPS guidance midpoint receives a 40x multiple as grid, generation and mission-critical demand sustains record growth, acquisition integration and cash conversion without material leverage or project losses.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade if a fresh mark clears expected-return, base-upside, payoff and margin-of-safety gates while Electric margins, backlog conversion, free cash flow and acquisition integration remain sound and a current accepted relationship exists; downgrade if backlog or RPO contracts without conversion, margins deteriorate, project losses or collection problems rise, free cash flow misses guidance, leverage increases without commensurate earnings, acquisitions impair returns, or projects are cancelled or deferred.
